done_when: Inline task mode uses the repo param, doesn't lock output files, and fails closed on step failures.
need: task=inline runs fail with Exception calling ReadAllText on .ps1.out because the file is locked by another process. Also inline ignores repo= param and runs from F:\AIBridge. Finally inline reports TASK RESULT: PASS even when steps fail.
title: AIBridge task mode file lock crash and missing repo param
